sql: with o as (select lo.market_ticker t, lo.strategy s, lo.side os, lo.action oa, f.side fs, f.price fp, f.quantity q, coalesce(f.fee,0) fee from live_orders lo join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id = lo.kalshi_order_id where lo.created_at > now() - interval '60 days' and lo.strategy like '%mmsell%'), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker t, quantity, realized_pnl, raw_json->>'market_result' mr from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), m as (select o.t, count(distinct regexp_replace(o.s,'_closeout$','')) ntags, sum(case when o.oa='buy' then o.q else -o.q end) netq, sum((case when o.oa='buy' then 1 else -1 end) * o.q * ((case when o.os = p.mr then 100 else 0 end) - (case when o.fs = o.os then o.fp else 100 - o.fp end)))/100.0 - sum(o.fee) fpnl, max(p.realized_pnl) rp, max(p.mr) mr, max(p.quantity) pq from o join p on p.t = o.t group by o.t) select ntags, (mr in ('yes','no')) has_result, (pq = 0) flat, count(*) markets, sum(case when abs(fpnl - rp) <= 0.02 then 1 else 0 end) within_2c, sum(case when abs(fpnl - rp) <= 0.05 then 1 else 0 end) within_5c, round(sum(fpnl)::numeric,4) fill_pnl, round(sum(rp)::numeric,4) pos_pnl, round(max(abs(fpnl - rp))::numeric,4) max_abs_diff from m group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3
